buyer: Engineering lead or founder of a 2-10 person team on metered Claude API or Teams premium seats (roughly $1k/month agent spend) who has to explain a $400+ monthly agent bill; found via ccusage/claude-burn-rate issue threads and r/ClaudeAI cost posts. Not solo flat-subscription users.
paymentMethod: Stripe Checkout payment link in subscription mode (no backend); deliver access manually by inviting the buyer to a private GitHub repo holding the team Action
mvpScope: Free CLI (scan, show, comment) accurate on real logs: gitBranch attribution at least 80-90%, totals within 5% of ccusage, no prompt text ever written. Paid Team Pack = report --since 30d across teammates plus the GitHub Action rendering receipts from exported .prreceipt.json.
firstTenUsers: Free users first: repliers to the r/ClaudeAI 'what did this PR cost' thread, people filing branch or PR cost requests on ccusage and claude-burn-rate issues, and Show HN commenters. DM each with one question: would your team pay $9/month for a shared cost-per-PR report? Send the Stripe link only to those who say yes. Target 10 free users and 3 conversations with team leads in 30 days.

price.why: Flat per team (up to 10 devs). Under 1% of ~$150-250/dev/month Claude Code spend per Anthropic's cost docs, below a single $15-25 AI code review, and kept low because free tools (ccusage, claude-burn-rate) exist and willingness to pay is unproven.

mustHaveBeforeCharging: real-log accuracy check passed (attribution and ccusage parity)
CLI published to npm and used by 3+ outside users
one-page site stating the API-equivalent estimate label and no-prompts-leave-machine guarantee
manual delivery process for the Team Pack within one day of payment
README with desktop and phone screenshots of the main flow

launchChannels.name: r/ClaudeAI
launchChannels.why: Review's assignment: ask how people track PR cost and count unprompted replies; Claude Code users with cost complaints.

launchChannels.name: ccusage GitHub issues
launchChannels.why: Users already asking for grouping or cost features; the most qualified audience for a PR receipt.

launchChannels.name: Show HN
launchChannels.why: Free open-source CLI with a clear one-line value; reaches team leads and engineers.

launchChannels.name: r/ChatGPTCoding
launchChannels.why: Multi-agent coding users worried about token bills.

risks: LangWatch already documents a per-pull-request agent cost endpoint, and ccusage, claude-burn-rate or Anthropic could add it free
No evidence anyone will pay; demand is inferred from adjacent complaints (review score 4/10)
Most solo users are on flat subscriptions, so cost is only an API-equivalent estimate
Branch metadata gaps (worktrees, renames) could make numbers wrong and destroy trust
Teams may not want spend published on PRs
The team Action needs exported JSON from every dev, adding friction
killCriteria: Stop if 30 days after launch there are fewer than 3 outside users, no team lead says they would pay, zero paying customers after 5 direct asks, branch attribution is under 80% on real logs, or a competitor ships free per-PR cost comments. Leave the open-source CLI up.
